#
 Spiritual
 Translation
 of the Chapter


---


**
¶2.
** After
 the Divine
 Proceeding through spiritual truth had
 ordered
 the interior degrees
 of the mind and the states
 of life
 within
 them
, it
 descended
 and established
 its
 presence in
 the natural mind. It commun
icated with the Divine Good operating
 in
 the will,
 which
 set
 into
 motion the three degrees of spiritual progression —
 the successive
 tur
nings of state
 that
 are found
 above every
 elevated
 condition
 of
 good. The
 Divine Good
 sent
 forth spiritual
 influx into
 them
, vivified
 them with the
 breath
 of spiritual
 life, stir
red them into
 activity
, and
 pur
ified the
 natural mind with tru
ths. Now
 the residual falsities and accumulated
 contamination
 from the three
 containing forms —
 those
 of truth
, of
 falsity, and of self-love
 — which
 had been cast
 down into the natural
 mind:
 these
 it
 gathered together
 and deposited into
 the general body
 of kn
owledges in the ou
termost natural,
 enclosed
 within its
 boundaries
 and
 containing forms
. For
 this
 reason
 the knowledges in
 the natural mind are
 bitter
 and
 contam
inated.
 They
 have received
 their
 har
shness and
 b
itterness from the pur
ging
 and cleansing of the three containing
 forms.

---


**¶3.** When
 the Divine Love itself
 arose
,
 ascending in
 its elevation
 to the inmost degree, it
 purged
 the system of all
 knowledges of good and truth;
 it w
ashed it clean
 and loosened every
 accumulated falsity embedded
 within
 it
. It cast this
 residue
 down
ward into the great
 interior
 body
 of natural knowledge
, as
 from
 an
 elevated state desc
ending.
 And
 that
 refuse
 —
 the sediment separated
 by
 the cle
ansing of the system
 of kn
owledges — it cast down
 and min
gled with the general
 mass of natural understanding
. The
 inher
ent self
-organizing
 intelligence
 within
 falsity drew it
 together;
 and
 that
 intelligence gathered
 the refuse in
 this manner
:
 it
 solid
ified and fixed it into a stable
 form.

---

**¶
4.** Upon
 this
 consolidated ruling
 falsity in
 the natural mind were
 stamped the impress of every
 successive
 state and progression —
 the impress of the lesser
 and
 greater intervals
,
 of
 the cycles
 and
 seasons
 and
 ages
, the
 reflection
 of every
 discrete
 knowledge
 and every
 governing
 spiritual influence. It came into existence from
 these
 and was separated
 from their active power
 and
 cast into the general
 body
 of natural understanding
. Every
 out
ward form and
 interior
 seal
,
 every aspect
,
 teaching
, and purpose belonging
 to the whole
 system of spiritual influences
 was impressed upon the
 form
 of that
 consolidated falsity —
 because
 it
 is the residue
 and
 dist
illation of them
 all.
 Consequently, every
 knowledge
 that illumin
ates and every governing
 influence
 that turns
 in
 its
 cycle
: to
 one it serves
 as prov
ocation, and
 to another as
 confirmation.

---

**¶
5.** It was disch
arged into the body
 of natural
 knowledge in
 this way —
 as truth
 descending
 from the spiritual atmosphere falls
 into the general mass
 of understanding. It was
 compelled entirely
 through the operation
 of Divine
 power
 and the
 governance
 of heav
enly intelligences. It was swept down
 to the process
 of breaking apart
 and reforming,
 that
 same
 state
 in
 which it had
 first
 been ordered during
 the establishment of the spiritual constitution
 of
 the mind. And
 the general
 body of natural knowledge likewise
 conceived
 and gave form to it
,
 being
 itself
 the
 principal
 formative medium
 and
 sh
aping
 intelligence
.
 It sculpted this
 fals
ity into a coherent image, a
 lik
eness more
 transformed
 than any other remn
ant among
 the residual forms
 within
 natural
 knowledge.

---

**¶
6.** This process
 may
 be compared to an
 intelligence
 that takes
 the distinct
 impress
 of many separate
 kn
owledges and subjects them all
 to the heat
 of self-love,
 and mou
lds them into a single image
. These inn
umerable impressions and inn
umerable forms
 are perfected and
 become
 one
 unified
 body of
 falsity.

---

**
¶7.** So
 also
 with the ruling
 falsity within
 natural
 knowledge:
 it too
 was m
oulded and shaped
 by the force of the dominant
 desire within it,
 from the
 many teachings and purposes that belong to the
 residue of the whole
 system of spiritual states.

---


**¶8.** The arche
typal form of this
 consolidated falsity was permitted
 to exist for three purposes.

---


**¶9.** The
 first: That the entire
 system of spiritual influences would be reliev
ed and purified of the burden
 of falsity present
 within it. In the same way that
 the ten interior
 expanses of the spiritual mind had
 been cle
ansed and
 relieved of the burden of the three
 containing forms —
 so was it likewise
 done to the whole
 circuit
 of spiritual
 states,
 that it too
 might be freed
 and purified of the weight
 and
 refuse
 within it.

---

**
¶10.** The second: That
 this consolidated falsity might serve as a
 fetter and a prison upon
 the system of spiritual influences and the
 governing
 states
 bound
 to it —
 so that when those
 influences
 seek
 to elevate themselves beyond
 their proper order, the ruling
 falsity in the natural mind dr
ags them back as
 by an iron chain
,
 and they cannot
 ascend beyond
 what
 is the
irs;
 and when the powers of the spiritual
 circuit
 would consp
ire toward a deceptive end
, and it enters their intent
 to desc
end into the natural mind, they are
 unable to descend because of the
 fixed point of order that
 is nailed into
 the circuit
 of spiritual states
 upon
 the interior
 expans
es.
 This is one restra
int. But the
 other —
 because of the
 sle
epless guardian
 truths set
 over it —
 the
 entire
 system is
 kept in continuous turning
 and
 is
 never
 permitted
 to rest
 in any
 single
 fals
ity.

---

**¶
11.** The third purpose
: That the spiritual
 influx, the truths, and
 the loves that g
ush forth
 from the circulation
 of natural knowledge —
 and
 the streams
 of truth that flow across
 the surface
 of the
 natural
 mind and empty into its
 general body of
 understanding
 — and
 the tru
ths that descend from the spiritual world
 into the natural mind as
 rain
 desc
ends to
 the ground
 — and all
 the refuse and renewal
 that come down into
 it:
 the
 general
 body of natural knowledge will be a recept
acle and gathering-
place for all of these.

---


**¶12.** As
 for all the good
 and the vitality that descends
 into this
 body
 of natural knowledge, and as
 for the spiritual
 influx that the ruling falsity draws
 in through
 its breathing
 —
 that
 it
 might ag
itate the whole
 mass
 of understanding

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: After the Living Spirit constructed things and the worlds, he came up and set himself upon this earth. He gave a sign to the King of Glory, who turned the three wheels and caused the wheels that are found [to turn] up above all the mountains; he spread forth the wind to them, he breathed on them, he stirred them up, he washed the earth with the waters. And the waste and the accretion of the three vessels, they of water and of Darkness and of fire, which had been discharged upon the earth, he gathered them and deposited them in the sea that is within the walls and the vessels; because of this sea waters are salty. For they have received salt and bitterness from the washing out and cleansing of the three vessels.

The sea giant had stamped upon him the seal of the seconds and the hours, the seal of the days and months and years, the impression of the stars and the signs of the zodiac [and of every power that turns in the sphere.] He came into existence from them and was discharged from their power and cast into the sea. The images and the seals and aspects and doctrines and counsels of [all the powers of the sphere] were sealed upon the body of that giant, because he is the residue of them all. Consequently, each star that will shine, and each sign of the zodiac that will turn: of one he shall be its inducement, and of another its confirmation.

He was discharged into the sea like this, the way a cloud might discharge rainwater into the midst of the sea. They compelled him totally through the action of the power and the helmsmanship of the angels. He was swept down to the mill, the place where he was constructed in the setting up of the universe; and the sea also conceived him [and gave birth to him;] for its part [the sea fashioned him,] it being his chief sculptor and chief craftsman. It sculpted him in a likeness, he being changed more than the other residue of the sea bodies.
This is also the case with the sea giant, who too was moulded and sculpted by the power of the lust inside him from many doctrines and counsels that belong to the residue of the wheel of the sphere.
The archetype of the giant was constructed for three things.

The first: That the sphere would be relieved and purified of the burden present in it. In the same way that the ten firmaments were purified and relieved of the burden of the three vessels; so was it also done to the sphere, that it too might be relieved and purified of the burden and the waste inside it.

The third thing: That the wind and the water and the fire that gush from the circuit of the sea, and the rivers that flow upon the face of the earth discharging into the sea, and the rainwaters that come to ground, and the waste and rebirth that come down to it; that sea will be a hostel and gathering place for all of these.

As for all the power and the life that comes down to the sea, and in the breath that the sea giant will breathe and draw it into him that he might disturb the sea [; and there comes to be a] fullness and a [contest that] becomes between his movement [and the will to] purify; but the sea [...]

This matter is
 comparable with a craftsman who might take
 the stamped impressions of many coins
 and cast them on the fire, and
 mould them [to a single]
 image. These thousands of impressions and
 thousands of shapes [are perfected]
 and make a single body [
that bears the likeness of them all
.]

When the Father of Life came, rising in his ascent to the heights, he discharged the wheel of the stars; he washed it out and loosened all the sediment that was in it. He cast it down to this great inner sea like [ ... ] of the mountain. And that waste, the sediment of the washing out of the wheel, he cast it down and mixed it in with the sea waters. Its own thought collected it together; and the thought gathered the waste together in this way. It made it fast and fixed it [ ... ]

The second: That he might add a {fetter} and a prison to the wheel and the signs of the zodiac that are bound to it, so that when they wish to go up above, you can find the sea giant dragging them back as by an iron {fetter}, and they are unable to go up; and when the powers of the wheel would take a decision on a guileful thing, and it enters their mind to come down to the earth, they are not able to descend because of this stake that is nailed to the wheel upon the {} of the firmaments. This is one. However, this other one, because of its sleepless watchers that are set over it, it is turned all the time.
